node.label: Subsarcolemmal accumulations of abnormally shaped mitochondria
node.definition: An abnormally increased number of mitochondria in the cytoplasma adjacent to the sarcolemma (muscle cell membrane), whereby the mitochondria also possess an abnormal morphology.
